hero.title: Our School
hero.subtitle: Our 30-year journey of success and achievements.

1990.title: Foundation
1990.desc: Our school welcomed its first students. At that time there were only 10 classrooms, and the educational process began with new methodologies.

2005.title: New Building
2005.desc: A modern 3-story school building was commissioned, increasing student capacity and improving learning conditions.

2015.title: Digital Education
2015.desc: All classrooms were equipped with interactive boards and computers. Our school was among the first in the region to adopt the 'Smart School' system.

2024.title: Present Day
2024.desc: Currently, over 1200 students are enrolled at our school. Our graduates are studying at prestigious universities around the world.
